process_genarris_outputs_single: process Genarris JSON structure files from a single conformer directory into deduplicated partitioned parquet format
process_genarris_outputs: batch process multiple Genarris output directories using SLURM parallel execution and save results as parquet files
get_pre_relax_filter_config: extract pre-relaxation filtering parameters like lattice tolerance and partition count from the workflow configuration dictionary
structure_to_row: convert an ASE JSON structure dict into a standardized DataFrame row with CIF string and partition ID
refactor_process_genarris_outputs_single: refactor process_genarris_outputs_single to support a custom deduplication strategy instead of the default pymatgen approach
